description: Retrieves rule-level approval satisfaction for a GitLab merge request. This endpoint requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate and shows which users count toward each rule, not every user who approved. Use Get Merge Request Approvals for all-tier aggregate status and the complete approving-user list.

merge_request_iid.description: The project-scoped internal ID (IID) of the merge request.
merge_request_iid.title: Merge Request Iid

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the GitLab project.
project_id.title: Project Id

name: get_merge_request_approval_state

approvals_required.description: Number of approvals required by this rule.
approvals_required.title: Approvals Required

approved.description: Whether this specific approval rule is satisfied.
approved.title: Approved

approved_by.description: Approving users whose approvals count toward this specific rule.
approved_by.title: Approved By

contains_hidden_groups.description: Whether the rule includes groups hidden from the caller.
contains_hidden_groups.title: Contains Hidden Groups

eligible_approvers.description: Users currently eligible to approve under this rule.
eligible_approvers.title: Eligible Approvers

groups.description: Groups assigned as approvers for this rule.
groups.title: Groups

overridden.description: Whether this rule was overridden for the merge request.
overridden.title: Overridden

report_type.description: Security or compliance report type associated with the rule.
report_type.title: Report Type

rule_type.description: GitLab type of the approval rule.
rule_type.title: Rule Type

source_rule.description: Source project-level rule details when GitLab supplies them.
source_rule.title: Source Rule

users.description: Users explicitly assigned as approvers for this rule.
users.title: Users

full_name.description: Full display name of the group.
full_name.title: Full Name

full_path.description: Full namespace path of the group.
full_path.title: Full Path

path.description: URL path segment of the group.
path.title: Path

web_url.description: URL of the group in GitLab.
web_url.title: Web Url

state.description: Current state of the user account.
state.title: State

web_url.description: URL of the user's GitLab profile.
web_url.title: Web Url

approval_state.description: Rule-level approval state for the merge request.
approval_state.title: Approval State

approval_rules_overwritten.description: Whether the project's default approval rules were modified for this merge request.
approval_rules_overwritten.title: Approval Rules Overwritten

rules.description: Approval rules with their eligibility, counted approvers, and satisfaction state.
rules.title: Rules
